## History

Barbara Shaw moved to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to live with her aunt, having previously visited her [Aunt Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) the prior winter. As one of Anne's students at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, she wrote a student composition during Anne's teaching tenure.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_
